# Sample motion clips

These human motion samples are derived from the Bones RigPlay 1 (RP1) dataset. NVIDIA fitted
the human motions to SOMA and retargeted the robot motions to Unitree G1. The clips
provide example animations and poses for the MotionBricks demos.

The 38 BVH files and 37 CSV files listed below are provided under the
[NVIDIA Sample Data Evaluation License](LICENSE.txt), separately from the source
code and models. Read the license before using the clips.

For the broader dataset and licensing options, see
[BONES-SEED](https://huggingface.co/datasets/bones-studio/seed).

## File coverage

Paths below are relative to this directory. The sample-data notice covers only
these listed motion files. It does not apply the sample license to model weights,
ONNX models, robot assets, rig metadata, Smart Primitive documents, or scene files.
